This candidate implements only the witnessed producer profile. Byte 45 is a literal profile value, without general text or file-codepage inference.

implementation.bounded: At most 4096 bytes; AC1018 fixed XRECORD, no EED, one reactor, missing extension dictionary, exact 197-byte payload, source-ordered 13 pairs and marker bytes, known scalars/point, clone=1, matching owner and reactor soft-pointer role 4, exact boundaries and zero padding. Reject reserved BL and malformed lengths; clear result on failure.
implementation.references: Group 360 at bits 377..457 -> 0xb9, group 361 at 841..921 -> 0xba, group 360 at 1577..1657 -> 0xbd on the pinned body. Each group is an RS DXF group label followed by a raw LE 64-bit value; neither is a DWG H token and no H ownership role is inferred. Candidate accepts distinct dynamic nonzero <=32-bit targets that cannot alias root or owner.
